footerHint: Reads this chapter (EPUB) or page (PDF) in ~500+ character chunks ending at a period when possible. Position is remembered per book. The next chunk is prefetched while the current one plays. Change engine under Settings.
ttsErrorFooterKokoro: Built-in Kokoro uses KOKORO_TTS_URL (normally GPU Docker). If the service is down or this PC has no GPU, open Settings → Text-to-speech, choose OpenAI compatible, and set your CPU Kokoro (or other) base URL.
ttsErrorFooterCustom: Check the custom base URL, API key, and that the TTS service is running.
contextHighlightNeedSelection: Select text first, then right-click again.
